name: cesiumjs-copc-workspace
description: Cloud-native COPC streaming and analysis for CesiumJS

scripts.benchmark: npm run build --workspace cesiumjs-copc-benchmark && node packages/benchmark/dist/cli.js
scripts.pack:check: npm pack --dry-run --workspace cesiumjs-copc --workspace cesiumjs-copc-core --workspace cesiumjs-copc-runtime --workspace cesiumjs-copc-worker --workspace cesiumjs-copc-analysis
scripts.release:check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test && npm run test:coverage && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run demo:build && npm run check:packaging && npm run pack:check
